tickets.title: Prepare liquidity planning analysis
tickets.text: Review expected cash needs, emergency reserve targets, recurring income sources, upcoming distributions, and potential funding sources for Mira Willowdoodle and Arlen Copperwisp. Summarize recommended cash cushion, any portfolio trades needed to raise cash, tax considerations, and questions for the lead advisor before client discussion, addressing the shortfall in their six-month reserve preference due to wedding costs and remaining rent.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up by 2024-03-18 is to address the cash reserve and remaining lease impact.
